content: Definition of alias diagnostic event for the creation of a Fim configuration in the diagnostic extract A pre-configuration of the Fim function inhibition can be created on the basis of the following meta-classes: DiagnosticFimAliasEventMapping in this case the definition of alias diagnostic event corresponds to a single DiagnosticEvent DiagnosticFimAliasEventGroupMapping in this case the definition of a group of alias diagnostic events corresponds to a group of single DiagnosticEvent s
